Table name and dictionary Description are correct. (2) LANGUAGE FALLBACK: the scale was administered in Italian (97 Italian university students, University of Rome 'La Sapienza'). Note the Study 2 codes are capitalised (Sforgive*) where Study 1's are lowercase (sforgive*) -- that is a property of the two .sav files and is preserved verbatim.
